_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "imports" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "format" TEXT NULL, "first_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_day" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "decimal_digits" INTEGER NOT NULL, "opening_balance_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_digits" TEXT NULL, "art" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'emerald', "include_in_totals" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("include_in_totals" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "import_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES imports (id), "debt_side" TEXT NULL, "debt_due_on" TEXT NULL, "debt_reminds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("debt_reminds" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "import_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES imports (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "import_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES imports (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "allocations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "changes" ("sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "changed_at" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exchange_rates" ("day" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "rubles" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("day", "currency"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "to_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "every" TEXT NOT NULL, "day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "advance_day" INTEGER NULL, "advance_amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "next_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "on_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "reminder" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_done" TEXT NULL, "last_from" TEXT NULL, "last_on" TEXT NULL, "last_transaction_id" TEXT NULL, "last_import_id" TEXT NULL, "last_at" TEXT NULL, "made_from" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "read_at" TEXT NULL, "schedule_id" TEXT NULL, "time_on" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "currency" TEXT NULL, "decimal_digits" INTEGER NULL, "advance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("advance" IN (0, 1)), "posts_itself" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("posts_itself" IN (0, 1)), "outcome" TEXT NULL, "outcome_at" TEXT NULL, "next_on" TEXT NULL, "found_by" TEXT NULL, "import_id" TEXT NULL, "debt_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("schedule_id", "time_on"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "first_day" TEXT NULL, "last_day" TEXT NULL, "marks_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("marks_days" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), "mark" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX transactions_occurred_on ON transactions (occurred_on)
CREATE INDEX transactions_import ON transactions (import_id)
CREATE INDEX entries_transaction ON entries (transaction_id)
CREATE INDEX entries_account ON entries (account_id)
CREATE INDEX allocations_transaction ON allocations (transaction_id)
CREATE INDEX allocations_category ON allocations (category_id)
CREATE INDEX schedules_next_on ON schedules (next_on)
CREATE INDEX notices_created_at ON notices (created_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX notices_debt_day ON notices (debt_id, time_on)
CREATE INDEX transaction_tags_transaction ON transaction_tags (transaction_id)
CREATE INDEX transaction_tags_tag ON transaction_tags (tag_id)
